proposed_widenings.name: stat_block_replacement
proposed_widenings.justification: Polymorph's core mechanic replaces the target's game statistics with a chosen Beast's stat block. No existing OngoingOperation atom (roll_modifier, damage_on_hit) models this. This is a fundamental transformation atom absent from v4.
proposed_widenings.evidence: The target's game statistics are replaced by the stat block of the chosen Beast, but the target retains its alignment, personality, creature type, Hit Points, and Hit Point Dice.

proposed_widenings.name: grant_temp_hp
proposed_widenings.justification: The spell grants temporary HP equal to the Beast form's HP at cast time. No existing Effect or OngoingOperation can represent a temp HP grant. This is a distinct atom from heal_hp.
proposed_widenings.evidence: The target gains a number of Temporary Hit Points equal to the Hit Points of the Beast form.

proposed_widenings.name: save_gated_onset
proposed_widenings.justification: The ongoing effect only applies if the target fails its Wisdom saving throw. The ongoing_effect family has no mechanism for a conditional (save-gated) entry condition. The activation family has save_gate phases but its Effect type cannot express transformation, and activation is one-shot, not concentration-ongoing. A new surface variant is needed: an ongoing_effect with a save gate before the effect attaches.
proposed_widenings.evidence: The target must succeed on a Wisdom saving throw or shape-shift into Beast form for the duration.

proposed_widenings.name: temp_hp_depletion_termination
proposed_widenings.justification: The spell has a novel early-termination condition: it ends when the target's temp HP drops to 0 (not just when concentration breaks or time runs out). Duration.kind has no variant for this; all existing Duration kinds are purely time-based or concentration-based.
proposed_widenings.evidence: The spell ends early on the target if it has no Temporary Hit Points left.

notes: Polymorph conceptually belongs to the ongoing_effect family (concentration, single target, persists until condition met or concentration breaks), but four gaps block honest encoding: (1) no save-gated entry for ongoing_effect; (2) no stat_block_replacement operation atom in v4; (3) no grant_temp_hp effect atom; (4) no temp-HP-depletion early-termination variant in Duration. The secondary rider (target can't speak or cast spells; gear melds) is narrative/out-of-core and not proposed as atoms. Classification is atom_widening because the deepest blocker is the missing stat_block_replacement atom — a concept not present in v4 taxonomy at all.
